title: Place an order
summary: Trace a place-order request across the six boundaries. Toggle Current vs Locked target to reveal the ghost stages — idempotency, transaction and atomic side effects — that flip solid as Chunks E and G land.

stages.label: Client
stages.current: The checkout screen POSTs the cart id (plus chosen currency and coupon) with the session cookie.
stages.target: It also sends an Idempotency-Key and relies on an owned session — never a caller-supplied user id.

stages.label: Transport
stages.current: OrdersController guards the route with a bearer JwtAuthGuard and validates the body with zod.
stages.target: An httpOnly cookie session + double-submit CSRF authenticate the storefront audience before anything runs.

stages.label: Idempotency
stages.current: Absent — a repeated submit can create a second order.
stages.target: The idempotency key is checked first; a replay returns the original order instead of creating a new one.

stages.label: Application
stages.current: Loads the cart, reads each product sequentially, computes a subtotal and applies a coupon.
stages.target: Re-validates ownership, stock and price, then orchestrates the write inside a unit of work.

stages.label: Domain
stages.current: Pure helpers round money, convert from the canonical INR and apply the discount.
stages.target: Same pure helpers, extended with tax, shipping and a frozen price snapshot.

stages.label: Transaction
stages.current: Absent — the order is saved, then the cart is deleted in a separate write (non-atomic).
stages.target: withTransaction() spans order, payment, inventory, cart and audit; any failure rolls all of them back.

stages.label: Port + Adapter
stages.current: MongoOrderRepository saves the order via findByIdAndUpdate; the cart is deleted afterward.
stages.target: Session-aware repositories accept the transaction context and participate in the atomic write.

stages.label: Side effects
stages.current: Absent — no payment attempt, stock reservation or audit event is written.
stages.target: A payment attempt, inventory reservation/ledger and an immutable audit event commit atomically with the order.

stages.label: Persistence
stages.current: The order document lands in the self-hosted single-node replica set.
stages.target: The whole set of records commits together, or none do.
